items.reason: Source: "my shaggy jacket of the cloth called bearskin" — bearskin is a shaggy woolen cloth. "my shaggy bearskin jacket" reads to a modern reader as a jacket made of a bear's pelt. Restore the cloth sense; rest of paragraph (incl. R2 restoration of "first"/"again") verified clean.
items.new: Returning from my first morning stroll, I set out again on this particular errand. The sky had changed from clear, sunny cold to driving sleet and mist. Wrapping myself in my shaggy jacket of the cloth called bearskin, I fought my way through the stubborn storm. Inside, I found a small, scattered congregation of sailors and sailors' wives and widows. A muffled silence reigned, broken only at times by the shrieks of the storm. Each worshipper seemed deliberately sitting apart from the others, as if each grief were an island, incommunicable. The chaplain hadn't arrived yet. These silent islands of men and women sat steadfastly gazing at several marble tablets with black borders, set into the walls on either side of the pulpit.
